title: A story's check is shown against the figures its goal names
goal: backlog.py check or planning names a story whose goal lists outputs or figures (such as four totals) that none of its checks or its tasks' checks exercise, so a story cannot close on a check that passes without them; SP-fvztfmtm's ST-6bi7oe6y had a check (-k backlog_cost) that passed with no shared figure or session total and only a reading of the goal found TK-cm5gabpz
